scripts.build:linux: NO_STRIP=1 tauri build --bundles appimage,deb && node scripts/name-build-output.mjs appimage deb
scripts.build:linux-appimage: NO_STRIP=1 tauri build --bundles appimage && node scripts/name-build-output.mjs appimage
scripts.build:linux-appimage-portable: npm run build:linux-appimage && node scripts/enable-portable.mjs appimage
scripts.build:linux-deb: tauri build --bundles deb && node scripts/name-build-output.mjs deb
scripts.build:windows: tauri build --bundles msi && node scripts/name-build-output.mjs msi
scripts.build:windows-portable: npm run build:binary && node scripts/enable-portable.mjs windows
scripts.build:macos: tauri build --bundles dmg && node scripts/name-build-output.mjs dmg
scripts.build:macos-universal: tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles dmg && node scripts/name-build-output.mjs --target=universal-apple-darwin dmg
